# Generated by AheadLibEx (Rust)
# Author: i1tao
# GitHub: https://github.com/i1tao/AheadLibEx

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

project(AheadLibEx_version LANGUAGES C CXX)

if(MSVC)
    enable_language(ASM_MASM)
else()
    enable_language(ASM)
endif()

set(AHEADLIBEX_BASE "version")
set(AHEADLIBEX_OUTPUT_NAME "version")
set(AHEADLIBEX_C "version_x64.c")
set(AHEADLIBEX_ASM_MASM "version_x64_jump.asm")
set(AHEADLIBEX_ASM_GAS "version_x64_jump.S")
set(AHEADLIBEX_DEF "version.def")
set(MEMORYKIT_CPP "MemoryKit.cpp")

if(MSVC)
    set(AHEADLIBEX_ASM "${AHEADLIBEX_ASM_MASM}")
else()
    set(AHEADLIBEX_ASM "${AHEADLIBEX_ASM_GAS}")
endif()

add_library(${PROJECT_NAME} SHARED
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/${AHEADLIBEX_C}"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/${MEMORYKIT_CPP}"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/${AHEADLIBEX_ASM}"
)

set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES
    CXX_STANDARD 17
    CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES
    CXX_EXTENSIONS NO

    OUTPUT_NAME "${AHEADLIBEX_OUTPUT_NAME}"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_NAME "${AHEADLIBEX_OUTPUT_NAME}"
    ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_NAME "${AHEADLIBEX_OUTPUT_NAME}"
    LIBRARY_OUTPUT_NAME "${AHEADLIBEX_OUTPUT_NAME}"
    PREFIX ""
    DEBUG_POSTFIX ""
)

target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}"
)

target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    MEMORYKIT_BUILD_DLL
)

target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    user32
)

if(MSVC)
    target_link_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
        "/DEF:${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/${AHEADLIBEX_DEF}"
    )
else()
    target_link_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/${AHEADLIBEX_DEF}"
    )
endif()
